profile.name: Faiz Muhammed
profile.summary: I’m an Applied Computing graduate in the UK with project experience in full-stack development, machine learning and IoT. I’ve built connected systems with Node.js, Express, MySQL and ESP32, as well as machine-learning projects with Python and TensorFlow.
profile.title: Applied Computing graduate · Software, AI & IoT

journey.title: BSc (Hons) Applied Computing
journey.description: I completed the Top-Up degree at the University of Huddersfield, scoring 90% in Data-Driven Artificial Intelligence and 86% in Software Architecture.

journey.title: Smart Campus Safety System
journey.description: I built a safety platform connecting ESP32 devices to a Node.js and Express backend, a MySQL database and a browser dashboard.

journey.title: Handwash Protocol Image Classifier
journey.description: I built a TensorFlow image-classification pipeline for the eight stages of the WHO handwashing protocol, using Cleanlab to find noisy labels and EfficientNetB0 for transfer learning.

journey.title: HudHack 2026
journey.description: I helped organise the University of Huddersfield’s first student-led hackathon for more than 60 students, working with sponsors, university staff and industry speakers.

projects.title: Smart Campus Safety System
projects.description: I built a safety platform connecting ESP32 devices to a Node.js and Express backend, a MySQL database and a browser dashboard. It includes REST APIs, JWT authentication, sensor logging, incident management and live monitoring for temperature, humidity and fire-exit status.

projects.title: Handwash Protocol Image Classifier
projects.description: I built a machine-learning pipeline to classify images into the eight stages of the WHO handwashing protocol. I used Cleanlab to find noisy labels, then trained and fine-tuned an EfficientNetB0 model.

projects.title: Hotel Booking Cancellation Prediction
projects.description: I trained a Random Forest model on historical booking data to predict cancellations, reaching 86.33% accuracy. I prepared and explored the data with Pandas, then used feature engineering to identify factors linked to cancellation risk.

projects.title: SmartGuard Intruder Detection & Environmental Monitoring
projects.description: I connected an ESP8266 to temperature, humidity and distance sensors to monitor its surroundings and detect movement. The system sends readings and alerts to Blynk for remote monitoring.

projects.title: Mobile Bluetooth RC Car
projects.technologies: Arduino Nano · C++ · Bluetooth · MIT App Inventor
projects.description: I built an Arduino car controlled over Bluetooth from a companion Android app. I wrote the embedded C++ code and tested the connection between the app and the hardware.

I coordinated attendee engagement and event logistics and worked with sponsors, university staff and industry speakers. I also supported cybersecurity workshops and society events.
